flashcard_questions.q: What was the Earl of Essex's real name?
In which year did the Essex Rebellion take place?
Which of Elizabeth's chief advisers died in 1598 after over thirty years of service?
Which rival did Elizabeth make Secretary of State instead of Essex?
How did Elizabeth respond when Essex rudely turned his back on her?
flashcard_questions.a: She punched him in the ear.

flashcard_questions.q: Which Irish rebel leader was Essex sent to crush in 1599?
What did Essex do in Ireland that most angered Elizabeth?
flashcard_questions.a: He made an unauthorised truce, then came home without orders.

flashcard_questions.q: Which source of income did Elizabeth take away from Essex?
Which Shakespeare play did Essex have staged at the Globe on 7 February 1601?
How many supporters marched into London with Essex?
The whole Essex Rebellion lasted just ____ hours before he surrendered.
On what date was Essex executed?
Where was the Earl of Essex executed in February 1601?
Why did the rebellion collapse once Essex reached London?
flashcard_questions.a: Londoners stayed indoors and would not join him.

flashcard_questions.q: Whose succession to the English throne did Robert Cecil secretly arrange?

notes: 15 cards: 5 person-to-significance, 4 cause-effect, 3 event-to-date (one cloze), 2 figure, 1 term. Dropped Essex's early court career dates as flavour.
